what: Teck Resources is a Canadian miner. After selling its coal business it is focused on copper and zinc, with the large Quebrada Blanca copper mine in Chile and zinc operations in Canada and Peru.
customers: Copper and zinc smelters and traders worldwide, mostly in Asia and Europe.
money: Quebrada Blanca in Chile, Highland Valley in Canada and Antamina in Peru
Red Dog in Alaska and the Trail smelter in British Columbia
moat: Long-life copper and zinc deposits in stable jurisdictions, including Red Dog, one of the largest zinc mines in the world.
risks: Quebrada Blanca cost far more and took longer to build than planned
Copper and zinc prices set earnings
Revenue fell about 15% a year over three years before last year's recovery
Only four analysts cover it in this data
opportunities: Revenue grew about 25% last year with a 21% operating margin
Copper demand grows with electrification and grid investment
Cash of about $4.7 billion against $6.8 billion of debt after the coal sale
watch: Quebrada Blanca production ramp and copper unit costs.
